Chapter 543: Chapter 3: Eternal Spring (Please Subscribe)_2

“`

“Just like that.”

Lin Yuan stepped into the Starfield Starry River, heading towards the Central Star Domain.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

The Taiyin Divine Spirit was rapidly absorbing the liquid within the Mysterious Gourd.

...

Due to the synchronization of the ‘Blood Rebirth’ Divine Skill, the Taiyin Divine Spirit’s mastery over this skill was on par with that of the True Body.

Therefore, in the absorption of the liquid ahead, its speed was extremely fast; within less than half a month, it had already absorbed the fifth type of cyan liquid, matching the progress of the True Body.

“My strength…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face; the Inner World of the Primordial Spirit Avatar had reached a size of one to two billion square miles, almost indistinguishable from that of the True Body.

Prior to fully comprehending the Complete Space Rules, due to the imperfections in their own paths, the two major Primordial Spirit Avatars had Inner Worlds that were smaller than that of the True Body’s foundational Inner World.

Only when the two Great Divine Spirits merged to become the Taiji Divine Spirit could they create an Inner World comparable in size to the True Body’s basic Inner World.

The ‘basic Inner World’ here refers to an Inner World that has not been enhanced by the Mysterious Gourd.

But after fully grasping the Complete Space Rules, such distinctions no longer existed, allowing their Inner Worlds to expand to the upper limit of ten million square miles.

“Now, my True Body, the Taiyin Divine Spirit, and the Taiyang Divine Spirit have the same strength; there’s no longer a distinction between the True Body and Avatars…”

Lin Yuan muttered to himself.

Now, his three bodies could all be considered the True Body.

The reason why the ‘Doppelganger Skill’ of Human Civilization is called a doppelganger is that the strength of the doppelganger usually doesn’t measure up to that of the True Body.

Moreover, while the doppelganger can die without the True Body dying, if the True Body perishes, the doppelganger will also die.

The Primordial Spirit of Lin Yuan’s True Body and the two major Divine Spirits could congeal out of the remaining single entity should any two of the three perish.

Just this point alone made them far superior to any Doppelganger Skill.

…

On the edge of the Central Star Domain.

Above a planet.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared silently.

“Finally arrived…”

The territory of the Human Civilization was so vast it took nearly a year for Lin Yuan to travel from the Milky Way Star Region to the Central Star Domain, which didn’t even account for crossing the entire territory of Human Civilization. Even so, Lin Yuan had spent nearly a year on the journey.

It should be noted that during this year, Lin Yuan hardly stopped, always traveling at a speed of one step every 530 light-years.

“In the Central Star Domain, I can no longer use the Great Transference Skill.”

Lin Yuan silently thought to himself.

To be precise, it was not allowed to use any means of spatial traversal.

The Central Star Domain was the heartland of Human Civilization; allowing unrestricted traversal and transference would create chaos.

Not long after Lin Yuan had arrived.

A figure swiftly flew up from the planet beneath him.

“Hahaha, Galaxy Master, I’ve been waiting for you.” This figure was also a Ninth Rank Evolver, specifically responsible for receiving and guiding Lin Yuan.

“Actually, I met the Galaxy Master not long ago.” The Ninth Rank Evolver was a purple-haired man, who was smiling at Lin Yuan at the moment.

“Met me?” Lin Yuan was somewhat perplexed.

“My name is ‘Xilan’; I was the fixture on Battlefield B0001…” Xilan briefly explained.

As Xilan looked at Lin Yuan, he thought: “The Galaxy Master has arrived much sooner than expected. Has he been continuously using the Great Transference Skill?”

Typically, an Evolver who has just reached the Ninth Rank would be extremely excited, especially after mastering the Complete Space Rules, willing to use the Great Transference Skill without care for fatigue.

It’s like having a new toy; of course, you’d want to play with it all the time.

What about the side effects of using the Great Transference Skill—the fatigue caused by mental exhaustion?

That’s not really a big issue; rest for a while, and it’s all recovered.

“I see.” Lin Yuan suddenly understood. Placeholders like Battlefield B0001, ancient Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefields, always had Ninth Rank Evolvers standing guard.

Not to take action, but to prevent the Ninth Rank powerhouses of the Different Species from taking action.

Naturally, if it’s a critical moment, they could take action, such as if the Tianyu Clan produced a genius who could rival the Galaxy Master.

‘Xilan’ might indeed strike to kill.

“`

“`

Even if he could be resurrected in the end, at least his growth rate could be suppressed.

When Supreme Beings resurrect their kin, they usually accumulate a huge number of them before resurrecting them all at once.

After all, resurrecting one person and a hundred people both require reversing the flow just once.

Of course, the backlash from resurrecting one person versus a hundred is different.

Wanting a Supreme Being to reverse the flow for a single life, unless they truly value them, is very difficult.

As for bullying the weak, competition among clans has never involved such a thing, otherwise how would the smaller clans, the ordinary ones, and the powerful ones be so obedient under the oppression of the peak clans?

“Let’s go, follow me down; everything is ready for the ceremony specially prepared for you.”

Xilan said with a smile.

The planet beneath their feet is akin to a transfer planet; to enter the Central Star Domain, one must pass through such a planet.

The Central Star Domain does not allow any space transference or movement by means of space shuttling, but it does have established space channels.

These are in place to reduce the travel time for those coming and going.

Beneath them, the transfer planet houses a space channel leading deep into the Central Star Domain.

…

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan and Xilan appeared on the transfer planet.

“Congratulations to the Galaxy Master on reaching the Ninth Rank…” on the surface of the planet, myriad beings stood, humans as well as different species, even with the number of different species making up half.

“Congratulations to the Galaxy Master on reaching the Ninth Rank…”

“Congratulations to the Galaxy Master on reaching the Ninth Rank…”

“Congratulations to the Galaxy Master on reaching the Ninth Rank….”

…

A succession of congratulatory voices deafened the ears, all congratulating Lin Yuan.

“So many different species?” Lin Yuan took a quick glance and was somewhat surprised.

“These different species are those who have sworn allegiance to our Human Civilization, or joined the Human Civilization Alliance…” Xilan explained on the side.

Several grand alliances of peak clans within the cosmos, such as the Tianyu Grand Alliance and the Insect Race Alliance and so on, are formed around the peak clans at their center.

The purpose is to gather all strengths and compete with other clans.

And human civilization… being a peak clan, naturally also has its own grand alliance, hence Human Civilization is also known as the Human Civilization Alliance.

The Human Civilization Alliance is led by humans and consists of one hundred and eighty-two powerful clans and six thousand three hundred and thirteen ordinary clans.

“Let’s go.”

“We’ll head straight to the space channel.”

“The Eternal Spring is on the mother star, it takes traversing through dozens of space channels as transfers,” Xilan said without pausing, leading Lin Yuan directly towards the space channel on the transfer planet.

Whoosh.

In the blink of an eye.

Lin Yuan and Xilan left the planet via the space channel.

…

“Is… is it over?” on the transfer planet, members of the large welcoming party consisting of different species finally dared to speak quietly.

Months ago, they had been brought here, continually ‘rehearsing’, all for the sole purpose of waiting for the Galaxy Master’s arrival, to shout the words, “Congratulations to the Galaxy Master on reaching the Ninth Rank.”

“Sister Luo Qin, that Galaxy Master must be an extraordinary human, right?” a diminutive member of a different species asked cautiously, turning to a human woman nearby.

As different species, even if they fully depend on humans, there are many restrictions; not allowed to use the Virtual World network until a certain period has elapsed, thus information is very blocked, and they hadn’t heard about the Galaxy Master.

But even without having heard about him, considering such grand arrangements on this very planet, they knew that this Galaxy Master was no ordinary figure.

One should know… this transfer planet typically receives a large number of humans or different species entering the Central Star Domain every day.

But, to exclusively welcome the Galaxy Master, it had stopped opening to others months in advance, solely in anticipation of the Galaxy Master’s visit.

Though there are many such transfer planets on the fringes of the Central Star Domain, setting aside one solely for this purpose is far beyond what a normal Ninth Rank Evolver could manage.

The diminutive different species member had also experienced other newly ascended Ninth Rank human Evolvers arriving without such treatment.

“Of course!”

The woman addressed as ‘Sister Luo Qin’ displayed a hint of pride on her face, “The Galaxy Master is the pride of our Human Civilization.”
